description: Simulates the Slack Web API including chat, conversations, users, reactions, pins, files, and more. Every method answers GET and POST, and arguments are accepted as a query string, a form body, multipart, text/plain or JSON, as Slack accepts them. A name that is not a method answers unknown_method before authentication, and every error repeats its code in the x-slack-failure header. The caller is identified from the token, which may be sent in the Authorization header or a form body field: any well-formed xoxb-, xoxp- or xapp- token is accepted, seeded tokens speak for their own user, and auth.revoke revokes. api.test answers without a token. conversations.list, conversations.history, conversations.replies, conversations.members, users.list and users.conversations page with a cursor and a limit, with next_cursor empty on the last page, invalid_cursor for a cursor that does not compute, and an unusable limit adjusted. Empty lists are answered as [], never null. A state snapshot keeps every store, including pins, bookmarks, reminders, usergroups, stars and Do Not Disturb state. The external file upload runs end to end on the emulator: files.getUploadURLExternal returns an upload URL on the host the client called, the bytes are posted there, and files.completeUploadExternal shares the file to channel_id or channels. views.publish keeps one Home tab view per user, replaced on each publish and guarded by its hash, and views.update finds a view by view_id or external_id; views.open and views.push keep the modal they open, without checking trigger_id. oauth.v2.access is called without a token, takes the client credentials by HTTP Basic or as arguments, and exchanges any authorization code once for a new bot token that the rest of the API accepts. conversations.open resumes the existing direct or multi-person message for the same users, answers a direct message with a D id that names the other user, and returns only the channel id unless return_im is set. Reactions and pins belong to the caller, a message is pinned once, and reactions, pins and bookmarks answer channel_not_found for a channel that does not exist; bookmarks.add takes a link bookmark with a title and an http or https URL. conversations.list and users.conversations list public channels by default and filter by types, and list a private channel, direct message or multi-person message only to its members.
